promotions.name: Stadtwerke Greifswald GmbH
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Greifswald material explicitly separates spontaneous direct charging from registered customer-card and roaming layers. The public charging section states that charge it easy is used only for DIRECT charging, allows direct charging without prior registration, uses credit card for ad-hoc payment, and displays the conditions for the selected charge point before start. The same first-party page then publishes the Stadtwerke direct price for the complete named normal-charging public estate: 0.50 EUR/kWh AC. It also publishes the blocking fee: 0.10 EUR/min from minute 241 after four hours. The page names the covered normal-charging locations (Bahnhofstrasse/ZOB, Friedrich-Loeffler-Strasse/Hansering, M.-A.-Nexoe-Platz, Walther-Rathenau-Strasse, Freizeitbad, Markt/Rathaus, Karl-Liebknecht-Ring/Moewencenter and Salinenstrasse/Museumshafen). A separate customer-card layer is explicitly priced differently (0.4367 EUR/kWh AC plus card/monthly/start/blocking terms), and roaming prices are explicitly provider-dependent, so no registered or roaming tariff is substituted into anonymous ad-hoc.

anonymousAdHoc.payment: charge it easy direct charging by credit card without prior registration
anonymousAdHoc.minimumBillingNote: The direct-charge instructions state that sessions whose billed amount is below 0.50 EUR are rounded up to 0.50 EUR.

promotions.scope: Named Stadtwerke/Universitaets- und Hansestadt Greifswald normal public charging estate listed on the current first-party page.
promotions.safety: First-party direct/ad-hoc semantics and price matrix are explicit. Customer-card and roaming layers remain separate. No tariff extrapolation from another CPO or backend was used.

nextSafeAction: Remove Greifswald from the unresolved charge-it-easy queue. Continue shared-backend probing on Einbeck, Bad Kissingen and FAMILA, while keeping station-specific pricing fail-closed. Continue exact Allgaeuer residual EVSE reconciliation in parallel.
